candidates.snippet: 1989: Invented the World Wide Web - Proposed the World Wide Web, laying the foundation for the modern internet and information sharing. 1990: Developed the first web browser and server - Created the first web browser ('WorldWideWeb') and web server, enabling the first successful HTTP communication. 1994: Joined MIT to found W3C - Founded the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) at MIT to standardize web technologies and ensure its open development. 2004: Knighted by Queen Elizabeth II - Received a knighthood for his services to the digital world and the World Wide Web.
